description: Small, multi-arch, OCI-compliant Docker images bundling CI lint/check tools, so you can lint any checkout with a single docker run instead of installing tools by hand.
rules: Pull the images from GHCR: linterpol (lean), linterpol-jvm, and linterpol-dotnet, e.g. ghcr.io/lahaluhem/linterpol:latest.
Lint a checkout by mounting it read-only at /work and naming the tool: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/work:ro" ghcr.io/lahaluhem/linterpol:latest hadolint Dockerfile.
Images run as the non-root user 'lint' and never write to the mount; there is no entrypoint, so pass the tool and its args directly.
The lean linterpol image bundles hadolint, actionlint, shellcheck, ruff, biome, swiftlint, rumdl, ryl, and container-structure-test; see LINTERS.md for the authoritative list with versions.
Use linterpol-jvm for JVM-language linters (ktlint) and linterpol-dotnet for C# (CSharpier); the lean image stays JVM- and .NET-free.
Run CSharpier in read-only check mode in CI: csharpier check .
container-structure-test inspects a built image, not files under /work, so mount the Docker socket or pass an image tarball with --driver tar.
All images are OCI-compliant and multi-arch (linux/amd64 + linux/arm64), so they run under Podman, containerd, and nerdctl, not just Docker.
